choice_rule: Use the single frozen candidate configuration. Select strongest matched control by validation primary metric from native-NaN HGB and HGB with added random mask augmentation; compare candidate against the higher-scoring control. No parameter tuning or final fixture access in phase one.
faithfulness_caveat: The prediction's available-expert set depends on the mask, so this implementation does not satisfy the proposal's claimed no-mask-to-output path. Validation is an empirical test of the specified pooling algorithm, not validation of MNAR invariance.
phase: phase-one-validation; final test not authorized yet
primary_metric: mean average precision averaged equally over validation conditions mcar_0.2, mcar_0.4, mar_anchor_x0, then over seeds 9401, 9403, 9407

selected_parameters.augmentation_control: independent per-row random additional NaN rate Uniform[0,0.5] on columns 2..19, applied only to already-observed training values
selected_parameters.calibration: one scalar temperature fit to pooled validation logits pooled across all four validation masks, bounded [0.25,4.0]
selected_parameters.expert_fit_rows: training rows where the selected subset is fully observed
selected_parameters.pooling: validation-fitted normalized exp(-mean expert log loss); average expert logits with weights over fully observed subsets; anchor-only fallback if no model available
selected_parameters.subset_columns: always [0,1] plus 6-12 distinct columns sampled from 2..19
